checks.claim: C4: Same-Z cost, nonnegative restriction and original-point mapping are correct for general psi.
checks.reason: I rederived the sign, shift and half-variance: s=1/sqrt(delta) gives sqrt(delta)W+h and density exp(-Z/sqrt(delta)-v/(2 delta)), matching (10) and (13). Tilt Section 1 takes any real psi in C_c^infinity((0,1)xR), and 'separable' in its Section 2 refers to the Banach driver input, not to a tensor psi. Chebyshev on the fixed v gives the moderate event, and restriction uses the nonnegative square. The penalty delta^(1/4) tends to 0, so the rate is 2I_psi-v_psi/2. Tilt (14), with delta=t^-kappa and R=t delta, carries no R^d loss because phi has unit mass. No signed first-mean restriction or source constant is involved.

checks.claim: C5: v_psi formula, finiteness, positivity and I_psi>0 are correct for the actual class.
checks.reason: By Tonelli, E Z^2 equals the integral of psi against h. h is bounded by (6), so v is finite. Since |sigma-u|<=1, h_sigma>=U_avg, so v>=integral q_avg*(Gamma*q_avg)>0 in both the Riesz and white cases. I_psi>=l>0 follows from (4).

checks.claim: C5: D_s is an intrinsic bijection of the class with the degrees 2, 1, 4-alpha for nonseparable psi.
checks.reason: D_r D_s=D_(rs) preserves the class, and D_(1/s) is the inverse. The Radon pushforward gives Gamma*(psi(u,s.))(x)=s^(alpha-1)(Gamma*psi(u,.))(sx), hence h^(Ds)_sigma(x)=s^2 h_sigma(sx) at each sigma with no tensor factorization. Unitary conjugation gives lambda scaled by s and I by s. The dx Jacobian gives v scaled by s^(3-alpha+2-1)=s^(4-alpha), which is raw variance, not a standard deviation or noise covariance replacement.

checks.reason: Nonemptiness comes from C_sep inside C_pos. S_2 is bounded by the finite upper rate, which is test-independent because psi changes only the mean test, and S_1 is bounded because I>0. Dilation at s=c^(1/k) gives S_c=c^m S_1 with m=(4-alpha)/(3-alpha). The s0 dilate gives V_1>0. On products h_sigma=k_f(sigma)U_q, so lambda_sigma=lambda_(k_f(sigma),q) and the intrinsic I and v equal the old ones. The ordering Q2>=V_2 uses each fixed test separately, with no interchange. Line 119 disclaims the Jensen, source L, first-mean and moment-order readings, and no strict value gap is claimed. Note: V_2^sep is not defined in the target; see minor findings.
